public_source_date_basis: The oldest verified public research source motivating this higher-rank radial objective is the initial March 10, 2025 arXiv submission of Nicola--Riccardi--Tilli (arXiv:2503.07069). The later global theorem of Abreu appeared July 30, 2026 (arXiv:2607.28376).
scientific_integrity: Motivating prior disk maximization and all known quantitative different-objective results are credited; no independent review or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns higher-rank Ky Fan sums on one-variable Gaussian Fock space, with radial sets centered at a fixed origin and small symmetric difference. The neighborhood endpoint is sufficient, not proved maximal. Its proof is analytical; finite diagnostics are non-certifying. Priority remains qualified and independent validation was not performed.
title: Sharp local radial stability for higher Ky Fan sums of Fock Toeplitz operators
